name: Adastra Fan Project: Cato's Triumph
source:
Spend a day with Amicus, Cassius, Alexios, Scipio, and Neferu as Cato's triumph makes its way through the cultural center of Ancora.

This is a short project looking into Adastra's Roman and Sci-fi aspects from a different perspective.

[From [url=https://hyponova.itch.io/afp]Itch.io[/url]]
